name: Meenakshi Goswami

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Meenakshi Goswami is a poet and retired school principal from Sonitpur, Assam. She received a National Award to Teachers in 2022 while leading CNS Higher Secondary School. The Ministry of Education’s citation recognises her work in curriculum development, language learning and children’s wider development. Her poetry collections include The Sensuous Zephyr, Waltzing Words and Lush Echoes.

In ‘Wings Without a Harbour’, her Kabita Live contribution, a wandering speaker leaves sharp words behind for woods, waves and open ground. Singing imperfectly becomes a pleasure rather than a failure, and freedom matters more than reaching a destination. Beneath that delight runs a quieter inquiry into identity and purpose.
